## SafiTech: Scaling a Development Team in 4 Weeks

### The Challenge

SafiTech, a fast-growing SaaS startup, needed to add 8 software developers to meet an aggressive product launch deadline. Their internal recruiting team was overwhelmed, and traditional agencies quoted 3-4 month timelines.

### Our Solution

TaasFlow deployed our pre-screened talent network, focusing on developers with specific tech stack expertise (React, Node.js, AWS). Within 2 weeks, we presented 15 qualified candidates. SafiTech interviewed and selected 8 engineers who were onboarded within 4 weeks total.

### Results

75%
Time-to-hire reduced
40%
Hiring costs saved

Engineers placed
On schedule
Product launch

> “TaasFlow was exactly what we needed. We went from desperate to fully staffed in a month. The quality of developers exceeded our expectations, and they integrated with our team like they had been here for years.”

Sarah Chen

## Sterling Law Partners: Supporting a Major Litigation with Rapid Paralegal Deployment

### The Challenge

Sterling Law Partners, a mid-size litigation firm, landed a complex commercial case requiring extensive document review. They needed 5 experienced paralegals within 3 weeks - a timeline traditional legal staffing could not meet.

### Our Solution

TaasFlow activated our legal talent network, presenting paralegals with specific e-discovery and litigation support experience. All candidates were screened for confidentiality requirements and conflict-check protocols. Within 10 days, 5 paralegals were onboarded and integrated with the firm case management system.

### Results

5

+30%

vs. full-time hire cost

Michael Torres

## Meridian Regional Bank: Meeting Regulatory Compliance Deadline with Analyst Team

### The Challenge

Meridian Regional Bank faced a 6-month regulatory compliance project requiring specialized risk analysts. Internal capacity was insufficient, and hiring permanent staff for a finite project was not cost-effective.

### Our Solution

TaasFlow assembled a team of 4 experienced financial analysts with regulatory compliance expertise (Basel III, SOX). All candidates underwent thorough background and credential verification. The team was operational within 2 weeks and worked seamlessly with Meridian compliance department.

### Results

2 weeks

> “The analysts TaasFlow provided were exactly what we needed - experienced, trustworthy, and immediately productive. They integrated with our team as if they had always been here. We avoided costly penalties and met every regulatory milestone.”

Jennifer Williams
Chief Compliance Officer, Meridian Regional Bank
